title: 2.5 Proving Statements about Segments and Angles

icans: I can write a two-column proof.
I can name and use the properties of segment and angle congruence.
I can complete a proof by supplying statements and reasons.

vocab: a logical argument that uses ____________ reasoning to show that a statement is true
a proof with numbered _____________ and their reasons in logical order

blocks.sec: Part 1 · Notes and examples (fill in each note, then work the example)

notes: Two-column proof: every statement needs a _______________: given information, a definition, a postulate, a property, or a theorem.

blocks.stem: Given: A, B, C, D are collinear in that order, and AB = CD.  Prove: AC = BD.

notes: Properties of segment congruence: Reflexive (A̅B̅ ≅ A̅B̅), Symmetric (if A̅B̅ ≅ C̅D̅, then C̅D̅ ≅ A̅B̅), and _______________ (if A̅B̅ ≅ C̅D̅ and C̅D̅ ≅ E̅F̅, then A̅B̅ ≅ E̅F̅).
Properties of angle congruence work the same way for _______________.

blocks.stem:
Name the property.
a.  If ∠1 ≅ ∠2 and ∠2 ≅ ∠3, then ∠1 ≅ ∠3.
b.  P̅Q̅ ≅ P̅Q̅
c.  If ∠A ≅ ∠B, then ∠B ≅ ∠A.
Given: m∠ABC = 90°, D is in the interior of ∠ABC, m∠ABD = 3x°, m∠DBC = (2x + 10)°.  Prove: x = 16.
Given: L, M, N, P are collinear in that order, and LM = NP.  Prove: LN = MP.

tickets.stem: M is the midpoint of A̅B̅. What is the reason for “AM = MB”?
